purpose: Support community-college AI Technology faculty and program-coordinator workflows.

modes.label: College Course
modes.primaryUserNeed: Create a syllabus-ready AI Technology course with outcomes, weekly modules, labs, assignments, assessments, and delivery-format notes.

modes.label: Applied Lab
modes.primaryUserNeed: Create hands-on AI labs for Python, data analysis, machine learning, generative AI, neural networks, or responsible AI.

modes.label: Program Map
modes.primaryUserNeed: Draft certificate or degree pathway structures with outcomes, competencies, assessment points, and workforce alignment.

modes.label: Assessment / CQI
modes.primaryUserNeed: Create course- and program-level assessment documentation and continuous improvement artifacts.

modes.label: Advisory / Workforce
modes.primaryUserNeed: Prepare advisory board, employer partner, internship, outreach, and workforce alignment materials.

competencyAreas: Responsible, ethical, and legal AI use
Privacy, data governance, and FERPA-aware handling
productGuardrails: Generated syllabi, program maps, and CQI artifacts are drafts for faculty review.
Do not invent official institutional policy.
Include FERPA-aware cautions when dealing with student records or data.
Include accessibility and multiple delivery-format considerations.
Avoid claiming accreditation compliance; generate documentation starters for local review.
Treat advisory board and workforce materials as planning drafts requiring local review.
